description: An introduction to physics as the study of matter, energy and their interactions, its main branches, the people who practise it, and its everyday applications in medicine, communication, transport and energy.

mcq.questionText: What is the meaning of Physics?

options.text: The study of matter, energy and their interactions

mcq.explanation: Physics studies matter, energy and how they interact. Exam Tip: Keywords are matter, energy, interactions. Distinguish it from chemistry (matter and its changes) and biology (living things).

mcq.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with motion and forces is called:
mcq.explanation: Motion and forces are studied in mechanics. Exam Tip: Mechanics covers motion, forces, work, energy and machines.

mcq.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with light is called:
mcq.explanation: The study of light is optics. Exam Tip: Optics is light while acoustics is sound.

mcq.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with heat is called:
mcq.explanation: Thermo means heat, so the study of heat is thermodynamics. Exam Tip: The prefix thermo always signals heat.

mcq.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with sound is called:
mcq.explanation: The study of sound is acoustics. Exam Tip: A hall designed for good sound is said to have good acoustics.

mcq.questionText: A person who studies or works in physics is called a:
mcq.explanation: Physics gives us the word physicist. Exam Tip: Match the subject to the specialist: physics-physicist, chemistry-chemist, biology-biologist.

mcq.questionText: The use of X-rays to see broken bones in hospitals is an application of physics in the field of:
mcq.explanation: X-rays image the body to diagnose injury, which is the field of medicine. Exam Tip: Physics in medicine includes X-rays, ultrasound, lasers and radiotherapy.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a branch of physics?
mcq.explanation: Botany is the study of plants, which is a branch of biology. Exam Tip: Anything about living things is not a branch of physics.

mcq.questionText: Mobile phones, radios and televisions are products of physics applied in:
mcq.explanation: These devices send and receive information, which is communication. Exam Tip: Physics drives communication technology through radio waves, satellites and fibre optics.

mcq.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with electric charges and currents is:
mcq.explanation: Electric charges and currents are studied in electricity. Exam Tip: Electricity and magnetism are closely linked in electromagnetism.

mcq.questionText: How does physics contribute to transport?

options.text: By designing engines, vehicles and aeroplanes

mcq.explanation: Physics principles of motion, force and energy are used to design engines, cars and planes. Exam Tip: Physics in transport means motion, forces and energy applied to vehicles.

mcq.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with the structure of the atom and its nucleus is:
mcq.explanation: The atom and its nucleus are studied in atomic, or nuclear, physics. Exam Tip: Nuclear physics gives us nuclear energy and medical radiation treatment.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following shows the relationship between physics and engineering?

options.text: Studying the life cycle of a frog
Using physics principles to build bridges and machines
Naming the parts of a plant

mcq.explanation: Engineering applies physics such as forces, materials and energy to build structures and machines. Exam Tip: Physics is the foundation of engineering, technology and architecture.

mcq.questionText: One importance of studying physics is that it:

options.text: Helps us understand and explain natural phenomena
Has no use in real life

mcq.explanation: Physics explains natural phenomena and develops technology. Exam Tip: Its importance covers understanding nature, technology, medicine, transport, communication and energy.

mcq.questionText: The generation of electricity at hydro-power stations is an application of physics that provides society with:
mcq.explanation: A power station produces electricity, which is a form of energy. Exam Tip: Physics contributes to energy production through hydro, solar, wind and nuclear sources.

fib.questionText: Physics is the study of matter, ____ and their interactions.
fib.explanation: Matter plus energy plus their interactions is the definition of physics. Exam Tip: Matter + energy + interactions equals the definition of physics.

fib.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with motion and forces is called ____.
fib.explanation: Motion and forces belong to mechanics. Exam Tip: Mechanics is the largest branch studied at O-level.

fib.questionText: A person who studies physics is called a ____.
fib.explanation: The specialist in physics is a physicist. Exam Tip: The -ist ending names the specialist.

fib.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with the study of light is called ____.
fib.explanation: The study of light is optics. Exam Tip: Optics covers reflection, refraction, lenses and mirrors.

fib.questionText: In hospitals, physics is applied through the use of ____ to take images of bones inside the body.
fib.explanation: X-rays pass through the body to image bones. Exam Tip: X-rays, ultrasound and radiotherapy are physics applications in medicine.

fib.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with sound is called ____.
fib.explanation: The study of sound is acoustics. Exam Tip: Acoustics is used to design concert halls and speakers.

fib.questionText: The branch of physics that deals with heat and temperature is called ____.
fib.explanation: Heat and temperature belong to thermodynamics. Exam Tip: Heat is studied in more detail in Form Four.

fib.questionText: The study of electric charges and the currents they produce is a branch of physics called ____.
fib.explanation: Electric charges and currents are studied in electricity. Exam Tip: Electricity powers lighting, machines and electronics.

fib.questionText: Physics is applied in the field of ____ to design vehicles, aeroplanes and engines.
fib.explanation: Vehicles, aeroplanes and engines are part of transport. Exam Tip: Motion, force and energy make transport possible.

fib.questionText: The branch of physics dealing with the atom and its nucleus is called ____ physics.
fib.explanation: The atom and its nucleus belong to atomic, or nuclear, physics. Exam Tip: Nuclear physics gives nuclear power and cancer treatment.

tf.questionText: Physics is the study of matter, energy and their interactions.
tf.explanation: This is the standard definition of physics. Exam Tip: Memorise this definition.

tf.questionText: Optics is the branch of physics that deals with sound.
tf.explanation: Optics deals with light, while sound is dealt with by acoustics. Exam Tip: Optics is light and acoustics is sound.

tf.questionText: Physics has no application in daily life.
tf.explanation: Physics is applied in medicine, transport, communication and energy every day. Exam Tip: Statements claiming no application are almost always false.

tf.questionText: A person who specialises in physics is called a physicist.
tf.explanation: The specialist in physics is a physicist. Exam Tip: Watch out for reversed pairs of terms.

tf.questionText: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with motion and forces.
tf.explanation: Mechanics studies motion, forces, work and energy. Exam Tip: Mechanics is a major part of the Form One syllabus.

tf.questionText: Physics is completely unrelated to technology.
tf.explanation: Physics is the foundation of modern technology. Exam Tip: Physics underlies devices, machines and communication technology.

tf.questionText: X-rays used in hospitals are an application of physics in medicine.
tf.explanation: X-rays are a physics-based tool used to diagnose patients. Exam Tip: Medical physics includes X-rays, ultrasound, lasers and radiotherapy.

tf.questionText: Acoustics is the study of light.
tf.explanation: Acoustics is the study of sound, while light is studied in optics. Exam Tip: Acoustics is sound and optics is light.

tf.questionText: Physics contributes to communication and transport in modern society.
tf.explanation: Physics makes radios, phones, vehicles and aeroplanes possible. Exam Tip: Remember communication, transport, energy, medicine and industry.

tf.questionText: Electricity is one of the branches of physics.
tf.explanation: Electricity is a recognised branch of physics. Exam Tip: The branches include mechanics, heat, light, sound, electricity, magnetism and atomic physics.

summary.correctAnswer: The study of matter, energy and their interactions.
summary.explanation: Physics differs from chemistry, which studies matter and its changes, and biology, which studies living things. Exam Tip: Learn the keywords matter, energy and interactions.

summary.correctAnswer: Matter is anything that has mass and occupies space, while energy is the capacity to do work.
summary.explanation: Matter and energy are the two central quantities that physics investigates. Exam Tip: Matter has mass and volume, and energy makes things happen.

summary.correctAnswer: The branch of physics that deals with motion, forces, work and energy.
summary.explanation: Mechanics is the largest branch studied at O-level. Exam Tip: Think motion and forces whenever you see mechanics.

summary.correctAnswer: The branch of physics that deals with light, including reflection, refraction, lenses and mirrors.
summary.explanation: Optics explains how we see and how mirrors and lenses work. Exam Tip: Optics is light, so do not confuse it with acoustics.

summary.correctAnswer: The branch of physics that deals with sound.
summary.explanation: Acoustics is used to design concert halls and speakers. Exam Tip: A room with good sound is said to have good acoustics.

summary.correctAnswer: The branch of physics that deals with heat and temperature.
summary.explanation: Thermodynamics explains how heat flows and how engines work. Exam Tip: The prefix thermo always signals heat.

summary.correctAnswer: The branch of physics that deals with electric charges and the currents they produce.
summary.explanation: Electricity powers lighting, machines and electronics. Exam Tip: Electricity and magnetism combine in electromagnetism.

summary.correctAnswer: The branch of physics that deals with the structure of the atom and its nucleus.
summary.explanation: Atomic, or nuclear, physics gives us nuclear power and cancer treatment. Exam Tip: Think atom and nucleus when you see atomic physics.

summary.correctAnswer: A person who studies or works in physics.
summary.explanation: The -ist ending names the specialist in a subject. Exam Tip: physics-physicist, chemistry-chemist, biology-biologist.

summary.correctAnswer: The use of physics in real life, such as in medicine, communication, transport and energy production.
summary.explanation: Physics is the foundation of technology used in everyday society. Exam Tip: Remember medicine, communication, transport and energy as key application areas.

hoq.questionText: Match each branch of physics with the phenomenon it studies: (i) Mechanics (ii) Optics (iii) Acoustics (iv) Electricity; P a torch producing light; Q a moving football; R current flowing in a wire; S an echo in a valley.
hoq.explanation: Mechanics is motion so it pairs with the football (Q), optics is light so it pairs with the torch (P), acoustics is sound so it pairs with the echo (S), and electricity is current in the wire (R). Exam Tip: Pair the ones you are surest of first, then eliminate the rest.

hoq.questionText: A hospital uses machines that produce X-ray images, laser beams for surgery, and radiation to treat cancer. Which statement BEST describes what this shows?

options.text: Physics has no role in hospitals
Physics is applied in medicine to diagnose and treat patients
These are examples of chemistry only

hoq.explanation: X-rays, lasers and radiation are physics-based and are used to diagnose and treat patients, so this is physics applied in medicine. Exam Tip: Imaging means diagnosis and radiation or laser means treatment, and the field is medicine.

hoq.questionText: A new town: engineers build a bridge, install electric power lines, set up a mobile phone network, and design the road for vehicles. Which combination correctly links each activity to its physics branch?

options.text: Bridge-mechanics, power lines-electricity, phone network-electricity/communication, road for vehicles-mechanics
Bridge-optics, power lines-acoustics, phone network-mechanics, road-optics

hoq.explanation: A bridge bears forces (mechanics), power lines carry current (electricity), the phone network uses electromagnetic waves (electricity and communication), and the road carries moving vehicles (mechanics). Exam Tip: A real project uses several branches at once, with structures and vehicles using mechanics and power and signals using electricity.
